name: Fix qqbot streaming message editing failure

description: Fix qqbot streaming: correct capabilities declaration and add edit capability check

asi.fix: 1. Set capabilities.streaming=false and matrix.messaging.streaming='none' to correctly declare qqbot's actual capabilities. 2. Add edit capability check in message-send.ts to auto-downgrade partial/draft streamMode to 'off' when channel doesn't support edit.
asi.hypothesis: qqbot capabilities.streaming=true and matrix.messaging.streaming='post-edit' caused send-message.ts to attempt edit operations that fail because qqbot doesn't support edit
asi.root_cause: send-message.ts auto-streaming (shouldAutoStream) triggered for messages >160 chars, which uses /api/message/action edit, but qqbot has editable:false
